svg.text: GHOSTED: Brett Bullet-Points, explore (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Illustrator Phase 1-2: local references, 10 rough thumbnails, 3 directions, one pick. Hand-drawn Bezier half outlines lifted to round bodies (Ricky sketch library); palette rows only.
REFERENCES (local only, the locked family; no web)
Kit v5 (hero)
Ricky v1
Ghostie v7
ATS-9000 v1
Auntie Dot v1
Dot v1 lineup at the game camera (x1.5): the whole family on grass
THUMBNAILS (10). Top: front, rough. Below: the same at the game camera (x3, 26 m, pitch 42, net yaw 5), at 1.05 x Kit.
1 wedge, swoop, halo, red vest
2 capsule all green (BMGD)
3 bean, slick, profile frame
4 box, cream vest
5 wedge, apricot, hips
6 wedge, oxford shirt only
7 capsule, frame, red
8 wedge, brown hair
9 bean, apricot, halo
10 wedge, no halo
DIRECTIONS (3), developed: front, 3/4, back; then the game camera (x3): Brett left, Kit right (real v7 render)
A. THE WEDGE (pick)
Chest out, square shoulders, narrow waist: wide at
the TOP, the opposite of Ricky's bell and Dot's pear.
Blond swoop, red sweater vest over a white shirt,
the green ring floating above: the LinkedIn
networker. Grin = white teeth over an ink smile
line; with his chin-up carriage it reads as a grin
at 1x (body map E). The ring reads as a halo.
B. CAPSULE + HALO (BMGD hint)
The hint as given, in a cream vest. At the game
camera it reads as 'Kit in a cream jumper': the
same capsule as Kit. Cream sits close to the lawn
and the path in value (see notes).
C. PROFILE FRAME
The ring stands up behind the head, like the
#OpenToWork photo frame. It reads at pitch 42, but
as a ring ROUND the head, which is what Ricky's
lilac headset band already looks like in the lineup.
From the back it hides the whole head.
